author: PeasantGamer
quote: This game is amazing. I don’t even know if the creators of it know that they made a classic with this. On my second playthrough now. Please I’m begging for some DLC. The story and gameplay are top of the line. Once I started, I couldn’t stop playing.

author: PeasantGamer
quote: To the team that made this game, if your goal was to destroy and bury an entire legacy, CONGRATULATIONS!!! You have succeeded. This game was obviously made with a certain political agenda, a leftist agenda. It is made to push a certain narrative rather than being a true GTA game. The most  anticipated game of all time has been killed by leftist politics. The game starts off as a chore simulator rather than a Grand Theft Auto game. They took away all of the traditional things that made GTA great in the past, politicized it and gave us this crap. The Critic reviews are obviously fake, bought and paid for. The game is just unplayable for most people and it’s become the biggest disappointment in gaming history. Lost all respect for Rockstar for going woke. You have disrespected all of your loyal customers.
